title: 第五章  炼体九重
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶落看了眼时间，“竟然过去了这么久，都已经快12点了”，“你吃饭去吗？”

“去啊”，“一起去吧。”

“哦，那个沈老师让我和她一起去，我得现再去一下她的办公室。”

“没事，那一起去呗，正好我也有点修炼上的问题要问一下老师。”

在去办公室的路上，并排行走的两人不知吸引了多少人的目光，再次到达办公室，叶落发现沈苍月已经换上了休闲的便装，叶落一下子就看呆了，秦月星一看，狠狠地拧了叶落腰间的肉，“别看了，我也没见你这么看过我呀。

沈苍月饶有深意地看了秦月星一眼，“走吧，去吃饭吧，已经挺晚的了。”

食堂倒是比较近，“今天我请客，想吃什么就点”，沈苍月笑道，

“好，那我们就不客气了。”

刚点完菜，只听见门口闹闹嚷嚷，“谁啊，连饭都吃不安生？”周围人都开始抱怨起来，但看到来人后却都是闭了嘴，

“哪个是叶落？给我站出来？”

叶落听到自己的名字倏地抬起了头，“是有人喊我吗？”，秦月星眉头一皱，“，南宫沧，这家伙怎么来了”，一旁的沈苍月无动于衷。

“我就是叶落，怎么了？”叶铭站起了身，

“你就是叶落，真是找死，居然敢碰我的女人”，说完，一拳朝着叶落挥舞过来，

“砰！”两拳相撞，竟然是南宫沧后退数步，“什么，怎么可能？”

不管是一旁的沈苍月，秦月星还是在食堂里吃饭的同学都瞪大了双眼，南宫沧可是学校的有名的恶霸，学校里许多人看他不爽，但也都碍于实力不敢说什么。而现在和一个无名小卒对拳，竟然落了下风，虽说在学院里是不能发挥炼体级以上的实力的，但也太离谱了吧。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ye Luo looked at the time, "It's been so long, it's almost 12 o'clock", "Are you going to eat?"

"Go", "Let's go together."

"Oh, that Teacher Shen asked me to go with her. I have to go to her office again now."

"It's okay, let's go together then. It just so happens that I also have some questions about cultivation that I want to ask the teacher."

On the way to the office, the two people walking side by side attracted the attention of many people. When they arrived at the office again, Ye Luo found that Shen Cangyue had changed into casual clothes. Ye Luo was stunned for a moment. Qin Yuexing took a look and pinched the flesh of Ye Luo's waist, "Don't look, I haven't seen you look at me like this.

Shen Cangyue glanced at Qin Yuexing thoughtfully, "Let's go and eat, it's already quite late."

The cafeteria is relatively close. "I'm treating you today. You can order whatever you want to eat," Shen Cangyue said with a smile.

"Okay, then we're welcome."

Just after ordering the food, I heard people shouting at the door, "Who is it? You can't even eat to make a living?""People around started to complain, but when they saw the person coming, they all shut up.

"Which one is Ye Luo?Stand up for me?"

Ye Luo suddenly raised his head when he heard his name, "Did someone call me?"Qin Yuexing frowned, "Nangong Cang, why is this guy here?" Shen Cangyue on the side was indifferent.

"I am Ye Luo, what's wrong?"Ye Ming stood up,

"You are Ye Luo. You are really looking for death. You dare to touch my woman." After saying that, he swung his fist towards Ye Luo.

"Bang!The two fists collided, and Nangong Cang took a few steps back, "What, how is that possible?""

Whether it was Shen Cangyue, Qin Yuexing or the classmates eating in the cafeteria, their eyes widened. Nangong Cang was a famous bully in the school. Many people in the school were unhappy with him, but they did not dare to say anything due to their strength.And now, he was at a disadvantage in a fistfight with an unknown person. Even though one could not display his strength above the physical training level in the academy, it was too outrageous.
